propositions: acli_graph.py hand-rolls three identical nextPageToken cursor loops without runaway-token guards; a server repeating the same token causes infinite loops (cabc bug class).
The shared _iter_cursor_pages iterator centralizes cursor logic, terminates on isLast:true or absent token, and raises RunawayPaginationError when the same non-null token appears twice consecutively.
RunawayPaginationError must escape each map's fail-open exception handler to preserve the data-integrity signal; ordinary transport exceptions continue to degrade to partial maps.
The three acli_graph maps (readers) are rewired to consume the shared iterator; no hand-rolled pagination loops remain after refactoring.
Offset-protocol pagers (fetcher._iter_pages, jira_datacenter/transport.py::_paged_search) remain unchanged and untouched; consolidation is out of scope.
